name: cadplot-mcp
description: Safety-first local AutoCAD batch PDF planning, staging, publishing, and audit tools.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and audit approval-gated AutoCAD PDF batches.
interface.longDescription: Inspects local DWG copies, builds deterministic plot plans, stages approved jobs, invokes the opt-in local AutoCAD plug-in, and audits PDF evidence without overwriting source drawings.
defaultPrompt: Validate my CadPlot environment without publishing.
Inspect this DWG and create a dry-run plot plan.
Show the restartable publish operations report.
